tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every card. A step below white since v1.6.3 so the white hinomaru field reads against it. Every text token reaches AA on it in both themes; the lowest are `warning` at 4.65:1 and `destructive` at 4.90:1 in light.

tokens.name: foreground
tokens.usage: Primary text, headings and figures on `background`, `card`, `popover` and `muted`: 15.2, 16.5, 17.4 and 15.1:1 in light; 16.6, 15.5, 14.9 and 13.7:1 in dark. Also the fill of the inverted UI tooltip.

tokens.name: card
tokens.usage: Surface of every panel: stat tiles, filter bar, chart card, estimator, header and footer bands. Only 1.08:1 (light) and 1.07:1 (dark) above `background`, so its edge comes from `border` plus `shadow-soft`, never from the fill alone.

tokens.name: card-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `card`; the same value as `foreground` (16.5:1 light, 15.5:1 dark).

tokens.name: popover
tokens.usage: Floating surfaces: menus, popovers, select lists, chart tooltips and hover cards. Pure white in light so a floating panel reads above a card.

tokens.name: popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on `popover` (17.4:1 light, 14.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The one accent. Use it for the current choice (selected dataset pill, active view toggle), the primary action, links and disclosures, the estimator queue bar and result tint. As text: 5.53:1 on `card`, 5.11 on `background`, 5.83 on `popover` (light); 5.18, 5.52, 4.96 (dark). Behind its own text as a 10% tint it drops to 4.83:1 on card (light) and 4.34:1 on popover (dark, below AA).

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid `primary` fill: white in light (5.83:1), the dark ground in dark (5.52:1). Never literal white in dark: 3.42:1.

tokens.name: secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary-button fill (the vendored Button variant; unused in the app). Identical to `background` in light since v1.6.3, so a secondary fill on the ground is invisible. Proposed light value in the Roadmap.

tokens.name: secondary-foreground

tokens.name: muted

tokens.name: muted-foreground

tokens.name: accent-foreground

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: One family for every script: Inter Variable carries Latin and digits, Noto Sans JP Variable picks up kana and kanji glyph by glyph. Body sets font-feature-settings 'cv11'. Figures are always tabular.

styles.name: display-figure
styles.usage: The headline number: stat-tile values from lg (text-base, then sm:text-lg below it) and the estimated completion date. Tabular figures.

styles.name: title-section

styles.name: title-app
styles.usage: The product name in the header from md (14px below). Once per page.

styles.name: control
styles.usage: Buttons, tab labels, select triggers, settings rows. The filter-bar selects run larger (16px semibold at wide container sizes); see Audit.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: No data for this combination of filters.
styles.usage: Running text: dialog and changelog copy, error bodies, empty states.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label over a value: stat-tile titles, estimator field labels and result label, settings-drawer section headings. 10px below sm. Write the catalogue string in sentence case and let CSS uppercase it.

styles.name: label-field
styles.usage: Filter-bar field labels at wide container sizes (@2xl), stepping down to 14px and 12px medium. The same field is labelled with `eyebrow` in the estimator on the same screen; the Roadmap retires this style.

styles.name: micro

styles.name: chart-axis

styles.name: tooltip-value
styles.usage: Values in chart tooltips, right-aligned and tabular; series labels beside them use the same size at weight 400.
